headline: Wall Street gains as strong SpaceX and tech earnings boost investor sentiment
summary: U.S. stock indexes rose, led by gains in technology shares and a strong profit report from SpaceX, even as investors weighed ongoing inflation and central bank tightening concerns.
why: Broader stock market indices reflect investor sentiment toward corporate profitability and the macroeconomic environment, influencing capital allocation across asset classes.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Positive corporate earnings and AI demand optimism drove tech stock valuations higher.

why_moved: Better-than-expected corporate earnings reports, particularly in technology and aerospace, improved risk appetite and lifted major equity benchmarks.
